findings.title: After a merge the skill waits with --until done, which a merged story never meets
findings.detail:
SKILL.md:21 (Shape: 'a PR the person merged → `norn story wait <story> --until done --timeout 5m`') and :35 ('Before any gate': 'wait for the story to end (`--until done`, …)'). In packages/view/src/wait.ts waitMet, `done` holds only when the unit's own status is done (the round reached `$done`). A story merged while parked at `ready` stays parked at the gate; GR6 cleanup sets story_status done and removes worktrees, but the cursor never reaches `$done`. The wait times out every 5m indefinitely (or is refused once the story leaves the view). `merged` holds when pr_state is merged or story_status is done. B20: 'so that it never rejects a PR I already merged' — the supervisor never finishes that story. The assets term at packages/cli/test/unit/assets.test.ts:289 pins the wrong command.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Use `norn story wait <story> --until merged --timeout 5m` at SKILL.md:21 and :35, and update the assets term at assets.test.ts:289.

findings.title: Stacked JSDoc: formatStepTimeline's doc is orphaned above delegatedText's
findings.detail:
format.ts:220-225: the 'norn run list <unit> --text' JSDoc now sits directly above delegatedText's own JSDoc, so it documents nothing and formatStepTimeline lost its doc.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Move delegatedText (with its JSDoc) above the run-list JSDoc, or move the run-list JSDoc back onto formatStepTimeline.
